MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which pair of initials both use a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. m and n
   B. b and d
   C. p and t
   D. b and g

2. How does the voice move in the second tone? (1 mark)
   A. It falls sharply
   B. It dips and rises
   C. It stays flat
   D. It rises

3. What kind of syllable pattern do bàba, māma and dìdi share? (1 mark)
   A. They have no vowels
   B. A syllable is repeated
   C. They have three syllables
   D. They have only one syllable

4. What does 哥哥 (gēge) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Is, am, are
   B. Older brother
   C. Love
   D. Daughter

5. What do we call a word made of two syllables blended together? (1 mark)
   A. A final
   B. A stroke
   C. A disyllabic word
   D. An initial

6. Which sentence means "The bed is in the bedroom."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在桌子上。
   B. 床在卧室。
   C. 门在左边。
   D. 电视在客厅。

7. What does 星期二 (xīngqī'èr) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tuesday
   B. School
   C. Four
   D. Nine

8. Which Kiswahili day is Monday? (1 mark)
   A. Jumamosi
   B. Ijumaa
   C. Jumapili
   D. Jumatatu

9. What does it mean to listen for gist? (1 mark)
   A. To find the main idea
   B. To write every word
   C. To stop listening
   D. To repeat every word

10. Which Chinese word means "happy"? (1 mark)
   A. 月 yuè
   B. 祝 zhù
   C. 蛋糕 dàngāo
   D. 快乐 kuàilè

11. Which of these is a staple food that gives the body energy? (1 mark)
   A. 水 water
   B. 米饭 rice
   C. 茶 tea
   D. 咖啡 coffee

12. Fill the blank: 我____米饭。 (I eat rice.) (1 mark)
   A. 听
   B. 喝
   C. 吃
   D. 说

13. Fill the blank: 我用嘴巴____。 (I use my mouth to speak.) (1 mark)
   A. 说
   B. 看
   C. 摸
   D. 听

14. Which body part helps you hear? (1 mark)
   A. 鼻子 bízi
   B. 眼睛 yǎnjing
   C. 耳朵 ěrduo
   D. 手 shǒu

15. Which sentence do we use to name a weather picture? (1 mark)
   A. 太阳在哪儿?
   B. 这是太阳。
   C. 你好太阳。
   D. 我叫太阳。

16. Which is an extreme weather event? (1 mark)
   A. 云 a cloud
   B. 风 a light breeze
   C. 洪水 a flood
   D. 太阳 the sun

17. Where is the garden in 花园在房子右边? (1 mark)
   A. Above the house
   B. On the right of the house
   C. Inside the house
   D. On the left of the house

18. What should you do first when you get a spoken instruction? (1 mark)
   A. Listen to the whole instruction
   B. Walk away
   C. Act at once
   D. Guess

19. What does 再见 zàijiàn mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Hello
   C. Goodbye
   D. Good morning

20. What does 再见 (zàijiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Hello
   B. Goodbye
   C. Classmates
   D. Good morning

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Write three birthday activities in Chinese or English. (3 marks)

22. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Today there are clouds." (2 marks)

23. Write in Chinese with pinyin: "The sofa is beside the door." (2 marks)

24. Name the days of the week from Monday to Wednesday in Chinese with pinyin. (3 marks)

25. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" (2 marks)

26. Write the five weather words in pinyin. (3 marks)

27. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Goodbye!" and "Thank you!" (4 marks)

28. Read jiào, nǐ and hǎo and write each with its Chinese character and meaning. (3 marks)

29. Write the question for "Who is this?" and answer it with "This is my father", with pinyin. (2 marks)

30. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 三 and 什么. (2 marks)

31. Read the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马 and explain how the tone changes meaning. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #7 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — p and t
   p, t and k are said with a puff of air.

2. D — It rises
   The second tone rises, like asking "What?"

3. B — A syllable is repeated
   Each word repeats a syllable, with a light second one.

4. B — Older brother
   哥哥 (gēge) means older brother.

5. C — A disyllabic word
   Dis means two, so a disyllabic word has two syllables.

6. B — 床在卧室。
   床在卧室。 (chuáng zài wòshì.) means "The bed is in the bedroom.".

7. A — Tuesday
   星期二 (xīngqī'èr) means Tuesday.

8. D — Jumatatu
   Jumatatu is Monday. Jumamosi is Saturday and Jumapili is Sunday.

9. A — To find the main idea
   The gist is the main idea of the message.

10. D — 快乐 kuàilè
   快乐 (kuàilè) means happy.

11. B — 米饭 rice
   Staple foods such as rice give energy.

12. C — 吃
   We eat rice, so we use 吃.

13. A — 说
   说 is to speak.

14. C — 耳朵 ěrduo
   耳朵 are ears.

15. B — 这是太阳。
   这是 + word names what we see.

16. C — 洪水 a flood
   洪水 hóngshuǐ is a flood.

17. B — On the right of the house
   右边 is the right side.

18. A — Listen to the whole instruction
   You need the whole message to follow it correctly.

19. C — Goodbye
   再见 means see you again, goodbye.

20. B — Goodbye
   再见 (zàijiàn) means goodbye.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: 切蛋糕 (cut the cake), 送礼物 (give gifts), 唱歌 (sing), 和朋友一起玩 (play with friends). Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: 今天有云。 jīntiān yǒu yún.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: 沙发在门旁边。 shāfā zài mén pángbiān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期一 xīngqīyī, 星期二 xīngqī'èr, 星期三 xīngqīsān.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each day.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: tàiyáng, yún, fēng, yǔ, xuě.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for two, 2 marks for four, 3 marks for all five.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: 再见! zàijiàn! 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: 叫 jiào (to be called), 你 nǐ (you), 好 hǎo (good).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: 这是谁? zhè shì shéi? 这是我爸爸。 zhè shì wǒ bàba.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the question and 1 mark for the answer.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: 三: sān, three. 什么: shénme, what.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Māma qí mǎ, mǎ màn, māma mà mǎ. Mum rides a horse, the horse is slow, mum scolds the horse. The syllable ma changes meaning with the tone: mā mother, mǎ horse, mà scold.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pinyin, 1 mark for the meaning, 2 marks for explaining the three ma words.
